scenarios.purpose: Create exact known-basis SKITO, SOL, and MYST inventory in both wallets.
scenarios.naive_failure: Collapsing acquisitions would lose dates, basis, and deterministic tie evidence.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Every accepted buy creates a distinct source-linked FIFO lot.

scenarios.purpose: Exercise partial, multi-lot, fee-adjusted, holding-boundary, and overdrawn sales.
scenarios.naive_failure: A naive average basis or greater-than-or-equal holding rule changes report rows.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Complete slices report separately and impossible inventory is excepted.

scenarios.purpose: Move known and unknown basis slices between the two owned wallets.
scenarios.naive_failure: Treating wallet views independently duplicates or disposes inventory.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Matched views create one movement with original basis and date lineage.

scenarios.purpose: Preserve unknown inbound basis, mixed disposals, and outbound suspense.
scenarios.naive_failure: Using zero basis or ignoring suspense creates unsupported monetary output.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Known slices report while unknown dependencies remain exception-linked.

scenarios.purpose: Cover valued and blocked swaps plus supported and ambiguous wrapping.
scenarios.naive_failure: One-sided prices or assumed wrap equivalence fabricate basis continuity.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Exact agreeing swaps report; unsupported values and wraps remain explicit.

scenarios.purpose: Recognize exact reward and airdrop income while quarantining spam.
scenarios.naive_failure: Treating every receipt as zero or valid income misstates both income and inventory.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Valued income equals created-lot basis; spam creates no income row.

scenarios.purpose: Exercise fee-only and failed events with charged and uncharged evidence.
scenarios.naive_failure: Processing reverted legs or dropping charged fees changes inventory.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Only proven charged fees survive failed transactions.

scenarios.purpose: Prove stable ties, identical duplicates, conflicts, and record quarantine.
scenarios.naive_failure: File-order selection would double count or accept contradictory facts.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Coverage marks every record resolved, secondary, or quarantined.
